general.title: Why a PR walkthrough can pass validation and still be hard to read
general.describe: I made an HTML guide for reading pull requests. When I shared it with coworkers, the visual feedback was encouraging, but I still felt that parts were hard to follow. One person wanted to see the explanation before the code pane, which led to a layout switch. That feedback points to a limit of validation: source references can all be valid while the reader still lacks the context needed to understand a change.
